name: core
description: Checks every scientific project needs: known answers, units and invalid values, matching the paper, and adversarial review.

skills.name: known-answers-first
skills.route: Writing tests, or about to trust a new or changed numerical method

skills.name: check-the-numbers
skills.route: Handling measurements, unit conversions, missing values, NaN or aggregates

skills.name: paper-to-code-consistency
skills.route: Implementing or checking a method from a paper or written protocol

skills.name: adversarial-review
skills.route: Asking for a review of an analysis, a code change or AI-written code; results look too good
